list.name: site
list.label: Sito
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT site_id FROM waf.agg_requests_1m WHERE minute > now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY ORDER BY site_id
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT site_id FROM waf.agg_requests_1m WHERE minute > now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY ORDER BY site_id

panels.title: Regole in COUNT per sito (candidati would-block)

targets.rawSql: SELECT site_id, rule_group, rule_name, sum(matches) AS matches FROM waf.agg_matches_1m WHERE $__timeFilter(minute) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) AND configured_action = 'COUNT' GROUP BY site_id, rule_group, rule_name ORDER BY matches DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT $__timeInterval(minute) AS time, rule_name, sum(matches) AS matches FROM waf.agg_matches_1m WHERE $__timeFilter(minute) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) AND rule_name IN (SELECT rule_name FROM waf.agg_matches_1m WHERE $__timeFilter(minute) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) GROUP BY rule_name ORDER BY sum(matches) DESC LIMIT 10) GROUP BY time, rule_name ORDER BY time

panels.title: Disaccordi vs AWS default per sito e user_class

targets.rawSql: SELECT site_id, user_class, action, aws_default_action, sum(requests) AS requests FROM waf.agg_requests_1m WHERE $__timeFilter(minute) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) AND action != aws_default_action GROUP BY site_id, user_class, action, aws_default_action ORDER BY requests DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT rule_name, path, count() AS matches FROM waf.matches WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) AND configured_action = 'COUNT' GROUP BY rule_name, path ORDER BY matches DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT user_class, sum(matches) AS matches FROM waf.agg_matches_1m WHERE $__timeFilter(minute) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) GROUP BY user_class ORDER BY matches DESC
